title: SCDM-HTD: Spectral-Wise Conditional Diffusion Model for Hyperspectral Target Detection
title_zh: SCDM-HTD：用于高光谱目标检测的光谱级条件扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Hyperspectral target detection (HTD) aims to locate and recognize objects at a fine-grained scale, playing a pivotal role in remote sensing. Despite significant progress, current HTD methods primarily focus on feature comparison while neglecting distribution learning for background-target separation, which can limit detection robustness in practical applications. This paper addresses this issue by introducing a spectral-wise conditional diffusion model that reformulates HTD as a task of generating a detection map. Specifically, we treat background and target confidence scores as training samples and use the corresponding pixel spectra as guiding conditions to capture the distributional discrepancy between background and target through diffusion and denoising. To enhance practical applicability, we propose a lightweight conditional denoising network based on multilayer perceptron to map noisy confidence scores to their ideal counterparts and adopt a deterministic reverse non-Markov chain to skip sampling steps, thereby accelerating the generation process. Furthermore, we introduce a composite loss to improve background-target separation. This loss integrates constrained energy minimization loss to enhance target saliency and suppress the background by maximizing the target response while minimizing average output energy, alongside binary cross-entropy loss to classify background and target using pixel-wise labels. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, with improvements in both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual effects. The code is available at https://github.com/shendb2022/SCDM-HTD .

paragraphs.en: The advancement of remote sensing technology has propelled the development of precision Earth observation. Hyperspectral imaging is a widely used technique that captures three-dimensional data integrating both spectral and spatial information. The resulting hyperspectral image (HSI) comprises two spatial dimensions, which depict the geometric structure of a scene, and one spectral dimension, which characterizes the electromagnetic radiation of materials [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . This spectral information encodes distinct physical and chemical properties, enabling precise identification of ground objects [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Hyperspectral target detection (HTD) is a key task in HSI processing, aimed at locating and identifying targets of interest within a complex background at the pixel or subpixel level [ 10 ] . Compared to traditional object detection, HTD enables fine-grained target identification, even in scenarios with low spatial resolution and image corruption. As a result, HTD has been widely applied in various fields, including camouflage detection [ 11 ] , forest fire monitoring [ 12 ] , disaster response [ 13 ] , and urban and rural planning [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 遥感技术的进步推动了精准对地观测的发展。 高光谱成像是一种广泛使用的技术，能够捕获融合光谱与空间信息的三维数据。 由此得到的高光谱图像（HSI）包含两个空间维度和一个光谱维度，前者刻画场景的几何结构，后者表征材料所反射的电磁辐射 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 这种光谱信息编码了独特的物理和化学特性，能够实现对地物的精确识别 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] 。 高光谱目标检测（HTD）是高光谱图像处理中的一项关键任务，旨在像素或亚像素层级上于复杂背景中定位并识别感兴趣的目标 [ 10 ] 。 与传统的目标检测相比，高光谱目标检测能够实现细粒度的目标识别，即使在地物空间分辨率较低且图像存在退化的场景中也是如此。 因此，高光谱目标检测已被广泛应用于多个领域，包括伪装检测 [ 11 ] 、森林火灾监测 [ 12 ] 、灾害响应 [ 13 ] 以及城乡规划 [ 14 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Based on the availability of target priors, HTD can be categorized into target detection and anomaly detection. Target detection identifies pixels that match a given target prior, enabling high detection accuracy [ 15 ] . In contrast, anomaly detection locates pixels that deviate from the surrounding background, operating in a fully unsupervised manner, which enhances its practicality [ 16 ] . This paper focuses on target detection, where a single target spectrum serves as prior knowledge. Over the past decades, various detection methods have been developed. Statistical-based methods [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] typically assume that the background follows a Gaussian distribution or adheres to an energy minimization principle, detecting targets by computing statistical measures. While simple and efficient, these methods may struggle in complex real-world scenarios due to mismatches with prior assumptions. Representation-based methods [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] formulate HTD as an optimization problem, estimating representation components via matrix or tensor decomposition with appropriate regularizations. These methods offer physical and mathematical interpretability but may suffer from handcrafted regularization inaccuracies and limited nonlinear representation capabilities. Deep learning-based methods [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] leverage neural networks to extract discriminative features. To mitigate the challenge of limited labeled samples, strategies such as transfer learning [ 23 ] , data augmentation [ 24 ] , and unsupervised learning [ 25 ] have been explored. However, these data-driven methods often rely on deep network architectures, which may introduce redundancy and lack physical interpretability. Furthermore, the absence of explicit data distribution learning can compromise detection robustness in real-world applications.

paragraphs.en: To capture data distribution for background-target discrimination, several distribution learning-based methods have been explored. For example, Xie et al. [ 26 ] proposed a background reconstruction model that estimates the background distribution using an adversarial autoencoder (AAE) with a target suppression constraint. Gao et al. [ 27 ] leveraged a generative adversarial network (GAN) as an auxiliary tool to augment background and target samples, which were then used to train the detector. To address the challenge of limited prior knowledge and better exploit background information, Qin et al. [ 28 ] introduced a Wasserstein GAN-based approach that incorporates weakly supervised learning and channel attention to estimate the background and generate detection proposals. Despite these advancements, distribution learning-based methods largely rely on autoencoders (AEs) or GANs, which suffer from weak generative capabilities and training instability issues such as mode collapse and gradient vanishing.

paragraphs.en: Recently, diffusion models have gained significant attention for their ability to generate high-quality and realistic data. The denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) [ 29 ] , a cornerstone in this family, extends the variational autoencoder by introducing multiple latent variables to model progressive probability transitions via a Markov chain. It corrupts data by incrementally adding Gaussian noise and trains a neural network to reverse this process. New samples are generated by starting from Gaussian noise and progressively denoised through the reverse Markov chain. Leveraging this powerful generative capability, DDPM has been widely applied across various tasks. However, its application in HTD remains limited. Existing studies primarily use diffusion models as auxiliary tools for background-target discrimination. Some estimate background distributions for suppression [ 30 , 31 ] , and some generate diverse HSIs to mitigate spectral variation [ 32 ] . These indirect approaches do not treat HTD as a generative task, and their non-end-to-end frameworks may constrain detection accuracy and efficiency. Therefore, an efficient diffusion model that directly captures the distributional discrepancy between background and target is needed for improved detection.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，扩散模型因其生成高质量、逼真数据的能力而受到广泛关注。 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）[ 29 ] 是这一类模型的基石，它通过引入多个潜变量以马尔可夫链建模渐进的概率转移，对变分自编码器进行了扩展。 它通过逐步添加高斯噪声来破坏数据，并训练一个神经网络来逆转这一过程。 新样本的生成方式是从高斯噪声出发，并通过逆向马尔可夫链逐步去噪得到。 凭借这一强大的生成能力，DDPM 已被广泛应用于各类任务中。 然而，它在高光谱目标检测（HTD）中的应用仍然有限。 现有研究主要将扩散模型用作背景-目标判别的辅助工具。 一些研究估计背景分布以进行抑制 [ 30 , 31 ] ，另一些研究则生成多样的高光谱图像（HSI）以缓解光谱变化 [ 32 ] 。 这些间接方法并未将 HTD 视为一个生成任务，其非端到端的框架可能限制检测精度和效率。 因此，需要一种能够直接刻画背景与目标之间分布差异的高效扩散模型，以提升检测性能。

sents.zh: 然而，它在高光谱目标检测（HTD）中的应用仍然有限。

sents.en: Existing studies primarily use diffusion models as auxiliary tools for background-target discrimination.
sents.zh: 现有研究主要将扩散模型用作背景-目标判别的辅助工具。

sents.en: Some estimate background distributions for suppression [ 30 , 31 ] , and some generate diverse HSIs to mitigate spectral variation [ 32 ] .
sents.zh: 一些研究估计背景分布以进行抑制 [ 30 , 31 ] ，另一些研究则生成多样的高光谱图像（HSI）以缓解光谱变化 [ 32 ] 。

sents.en: These indirect approaches do not treat HTD as a generative task, and their non-end-to-end frameworks may constrain detection accuracy and efficiency.
sents.zh: 这些间接方法并未将 HTD 视为一个生成任务，其非端到端的框架可能限制检测精度和效率。

sents.en: Therefore, an efficient diffusion model that directly captures the distributional discrepancy between background and target is needed for improved detection.
sents.zh: 因此，需要一种能够直接刻画背景与目标之间分布差异的高效扩散模型，以提升检测性能。

paragraphs.en: To address the aforementioned issues, this paper proposes a spectral-wise conditional diffusion model for HTD (SCDM-HTD). The model estimates the distribution of confidence scores using corresponding pixel spectra as guiding conditions and directly generates the detection map. Detection is achieved by distinguishing between the reconstructed background and target confidence scores. Specifically, to obtain sufficient background and target samples, we treat the original pixels as background and generate target samples by mixing them with the target prior, simulating spectral mixture and variation. The corresponding confidence scores are computed using cosine similarity between the pixels and the target prior. We then introduce the spectral conditional diffusion model to estimate the confidence score distribution. In the forward process, confidence score pairs from the same position are progressively diffused into noisy sequences by adding Gaussian noise. To efficiently recover the confidence score pairs, we design a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP)-based conditional denoising network (CDNet), which embeds pixel spectra as guiding conditions. A tailored background-target separation loss supervises the denoising process, integrating constrained energy minimization (CEM) loss to enhance target saliency while suppressing the background, and binary cross-entropy (BCE) loss to enforce binary classification of background and target. In the reverse process, the detection map is progressively refined from Gaussian noise, with the original HSI serving as the guiding condition. To accelerate the generation process, we adopt a deterministic reverse non-Markov chain, inspired by the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) [ 33 ] , enabling step skipping during sampling. This acceleration significantly reduces the required number of steps while maintaining promising detection performance, facilitating practical applications. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed SCDM-HTD. In summary, the main contributions of this paper are as follows:

paragraphs.en: Existing HTD methods can be broadly classified into three categories: statistical-based methods, representation-based methods, and deep learning-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的 HTD 方法大致可分为三类：基于统计的方法、基于表示的方法和基于深度学习的方法。

paragraphs.en: These methods typically assume that the background or target follows specific distributions or principles to compute relevant statistics for detection. Classical methods such as the generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) [ 34 ] , the adaptive coherence estimator (ACE) [ 17 ] , and the adaptive matched filter (AMF) [ 35 ] operate under the assumption that the background follows a multivariate Gaussian distribution, detecting targets by evaluating the likelihood ratio. Under the same Gaussian assumption, the orthogonal subspace projection (OSP) method [ 18 ] detects targets by first projecting each pixel onto the orthogonal subspace of the background and then onto the target space to enhance the signal-to-noise ratio. Beyond distributional assumptions, some methods leverage energy minimization principles. For example, the CEM method [ 19 ] employs a finite impulse response filter that suppresses the background while enhancing the target by minimizing the average output energy and maximizing the target response. To improve generalization, various CEM-based extensions have been developed. Kernel CEM (KCEM) [ 35 ] maps data into a high-dimensional kernel space to enhance linear separability. Inspired by neural networks, hierarchical CEM (hCEM) [ 36 ] and ensemble-based cascaded CEM (E-CEM) [ 37 ] employ multilayer architectures with CEM as the fundamental module, incorporating nonlinear activation functions to improve representation. To address CEM’s sensitivity to the choice of data origin (centralization points), the clever eye (CE) method [ 38 ] treats the data origin as an optimization variable and derives a global closed-form solution. While statistical-based methods are efficient and effective for many HTD tasks, their performance can be limited in real-world datasets due to mismatches between prior assumptions and the complex, non-Gaussian nature of practical distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 这类方法通常假设背景或目标服从特定的分布或原理，从而计算用于检测的相关统计量。 经典方法如广义似然比检验（GLRT）[34]、自适应相干估计器（ACE）[17]和自适应匹配滤波器（AMF）[35]，都在背景服从多元高斯分布的假设下，通过评估似然比来检测目标。 在同样的高斯假设下，正交子空间投影（OSP）方法[18]先将每个像素投影到背景的正交子空间，再投影到目标空间，以提升信噪比，从而检测目标。 除了分布假设之外，还有一些方法利用能量最小化原理。 例如，CEM方法[19]采用有限冲激响应滤波器，通过最小化平均输出能量并最大化目标响应，在抑制背景的同时增强目标。 为了提升泛化能力，研究者开发了多种基于CEM的扩展方法。 核CEM（KCEM）[35]将数据映射到高维核空间中，以增强线性可分性。 受神经网络启发，层次CEM（hCEM）[36]和基于集成级联CEM的E-CEM（E-CEM）[37]采用以CEM为基本模块的多层架构，并引入非线性激活函数来提升表示能力。 为了解决CEM对数据原点（中心化点）选择的敏感性，clever eye（CE）方法[38]将数据原点视为优化变量，并推导出全局闭式解。 尽管基于统计的方法对许多高光谱目标检测（HTD）任务高效且有效，但由于先验假设与实际分布复杂、非高斯的特性之间存在失配，其性能在真实数据集上可能受限。

paragraphs.en: These methods formulate HTD as an optimization problem, aiming to estimate representation components through matrix or tensor decomposition, combined with various regularization techniques. Matrix decomposition-based methods typically rely on a linear mixing model (LMM) to estimate representation coefficients and can be broadly categorized into binary and unified representations. In binary representation, each testing pixel is modeled separately as background and target using distinct dictionaries, and detection is performed by comparing their respective representation residuals. Representative binary detectors include the sparse representation-based detector (STD) [ 39 ] , sparse representation-based binary hypothesis (SRBBH) [ 40 ] , combined sparse and collaborative representation (CSCR) [ 20 ] , target dictionary construction-based STD (TDC-STD) [ 41 ] , and weighted discriminative collaborative competitive representation (WDCCR) [ 42 ] . In contrast, unified representation models all pixels jointly using a combined background-target dictionary, with specific regularization priors imposed on the coefficients to separate background and target components. Typical unified detectors include the decomposition model with background dictionary learning (DM-BDL) [ 43 ] , dual sparse constraints (DSC) [ 44 ] , double dictionary-based nonlinear representation for target detection (DDNRTD) [ 45 ] , and the learning single spectral abundance (LSSA) method [ 21 ] . These unified approaches excel at subpixel target detection by effectively separating the target from the background. To further preserve the spatial-spectral structure of HSI and capture intrinsic correlations, tensor decomposition-based methods have been developed. Zhao et al. [ 22 ] proposed a method based on nonlocal similarity and rank-1 tensor decomposition, which effectively extracts spatial-spectral features and achieves robust performance under few-shot detection scenarios. Kong et al. [ 46 ] introduced a tensor approximation model employing a tensor double nuclear norm to capture both global and local low-rank properties, as well as the nonlocal similarity of the background. Although these methods offer physical and mathematical interpretability along with promising generalization capabilities, they face challenges in practical applications. On the one hand, handcrafted regularizations may fail to accurately capture the intrinsic characteristics of specific datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法将 HTD 形式化为一个优化问题，旨在通过矩阵或张量分解并结合各种正则化技术来估计表示分量。 基于矩阵分解的方法通常依赖线性混合模型（LMM）来估计表示系数，并可大致分为二值表示和统一表示两类。 在二值表示中，每个测试像素分别使用不同的字典被建模为背景和目标，并通过比较两者各自的表示残差来执行检测。 具有代表性的二值检测器包括基于稀疏表示的检测器（STD）[ 39 ]、基于稀疏表示的二值假设（SRBBH）[ 40 ]、组合稀疏与协同表示（CSCR）[ 20 ]、基于目标字典构建的 STD（TDC-STD）[ 41 ] 以及加权判别性协同竞争表示（WDCCR）[ 42 ]。 与之相反，统一表示使用组合的背景-目标字典对所有像素进行联合建模，并对系数施加特定的正则化先验以分离背景和目标分量。 典型的统一检测器包括带背景字典学习的分解模型（DM-BDL）[ 43 ]、双稀疏约束（DSC）[ 44 ]、基于双字典的非线性目标检测表示（DDNRTD）[ 45 ] 以及学习单光谱丰度（LSSA）方法[ 21 ]。 这些统一方法通过有效地将目标从背景中分离出来，在亚像素目标检测方面表现出色。 为了进一步保持 HSI 的空间-光谱结构并捕获内在相关性，基于张量分解的方法应运而生。Zhao 等人 [ 22 ] 提出了一种基于非局部相似性和秩-1 张量分解的方法，该方法能够有效提取空间-光谱特征，并在少样本检测场景下取得稳健的性能。Kong 等人 [ 46 ] 提出了一种张量近似模型，采用张量双核范数来同时捕获全局和局部低秩特性以及背景的非局部相似性。 尽管这些方法具有物理和数学上的可解释性以及良好的泛化能力，但它们在实际应用中仍面临挑战。 一方面，手工设计的正则化可能无法准确捕捉特定数据集的内在特性。

sents.en: These methods formulate HTD as an optimization problem, aiming to estimate representation components through matrix or tensor decomposition, combined with various regularization techniques.
sents.zh: 这些方法将 HTD 形式化为一个优化问题，旨在通过矩阵或张量分解并结合各种正则化技术来估计表示分量。

sents.en: Matrix decomposition-based methods typically rely on a linear mixing model (LMM) to estimate representation coefficients and can be broadly categorized into binary and unified representations.
sents.zh: 基于矩阵分解的方法通常依赖线性混合模型（LMM）来估计表示系数，并可大致分为二值表示和统一表示两类。

sents.en: In binary representation, each testing pixel is modeled separately as background and target using distinct dictionaries, and detection is performed by comparing their respective representation residuals.
sents.zh: 在二值表示中，每个测试像素分别使用不同的字典被建模为背景和目标，并通过比较两者各自的表示残差来执行检测。

sents.en: Representative binary detectors include the sparse representation-based detector (STD) [ 39 ] , sparse representation-based binary hypothesis (SRBBH) [ 40 ] , combined sparse and collaborative representation (CSCR) [ 20 ] , target dictionary construction-based STD (TDC-STD) [ 41 ] , and weighted discriminative collaborative competitive representation (WDCCR) [ 42 ] .
sents.zh: 具有代表性的二值检测器包括基于稀疏表示的检测器（STD）[ 39 ]、基于稀疏表示的二值假设（SRBBH）[ 40 ]、组合稀疏与协同表示（CSCR）[ 20 ]、基于目标字典构建的 STD（TDC-STD）[ 41 ] 以及加权判别性协同竞争表示（WDCCR）[ 42 ]。

sents.en: In contrast, unified representation models all pixels jointly using a combined background-target dictionary, with specific regularization priors imposed on the coefficients to separate background and target components.
sents.zh: 与之相反，统一表示使用组合的背景-目标字典对所有像素进行联合建模，并对系数施加特定的正则化先验以分离背景和目标分量。

sents.en: Typical unified detectors include the decomposition model with background dictionary learning (DM-BDL) [ 43 ] , dual sparse constraints (DSC) [ 44 ] , double dictionary-based nonlinear representation for target detection (DDNRTD) [ 45 ] , and the learning single spectral abundance (LSSA) method [ 21 ] .
sents.zh: 典型的统一检测器包括带背景字典学习的分解模型（DM-BDL）[ 43 ]、双稀疏约束（DSC）[ 44 ]、基于双字典的非线性目标检测表示（DDNRTD）[ 45 ] 以及学习单光谱丰度（LSSA）方法[ 21 ]。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, limited nonlinear representation capacity hampers their ability to fully discriminate between background and target.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，有限的非线性表征能力限制了它们充分区分背景与目标的能力。

paragraphs.en: These methods leverage neural networks to extract discriminative features or patterns from data for HTD. However, the scarcity of labeled samples poses significant challenges in training effective and generalizable models. To address this issue, transfer learning, sample augmentation, and unsupervised learning strategies have been explored. Transfer learning aims to utilize knowledge from a source domain with abundant labeled samples and transfer it to the target domain. For example, the convolutional neural network-based detector (CNND) [ 47 ] and the meta-learning method with a Siamese network (MLSN) [ 48 ] pretrain on classification datasets and transfer knowledge to detection datasets. Beyond spectral knowledge transfer, a recent method, transfer learning from high-resolution RGB images for HTD (TLH 2 TD) [ 49 ] , incorporates spatial features from RGB images containing similar small targets, employing box-wise detection to capture morphological characteristics. While these transfer learning methods alleviate the issue of limited labeled data, they may suffer from domain drift, where the knowledge acquired from the source domain becomes misaligned when applied to the target domain. Sample augmentation methods expand the training dataset by generating synthetic samples and train supervised binary classification models for detection. For instance, HTD-Net [ 50 ] employs a U-shaped autoencoder to generate target pixels and uses a linear strategy to select background pixels. The two-stream CNN for target detection (TSCNTD) [ 51 ] identifies background pixels via sparse representation and mixes them with target priors to ensure sufficient target samples. The Siamese Transformer network for target detection (STTD) [ 24 ] extracts high-purity background samples through endmember extraction, unmixing, and refiltering, while mixed target and background samples are generated via random linear mixing with target spectra. The triplet spectral-wise Transformer-based target detector (TSTTD) [ 52 ] treats original hyperspectral pixels as background and synthesizes target samples by mixing them with the target spectrum. Despite their promising performance, sample augmentation methods may introduce knowledge bias and noise, leading to distribution mismatches between training and testing data, which can cause missed detections or false alarms.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法利用神经网络从数据中提取判别性特征或模式，以实现 HTD。 然而，标记样本的稀缺给训练有效且具有泛化能力的模型带来了重大挑战。 为了解决这一问题，研究者已探索了迁移学习、样本增强和无监督学习等策略。 迁移学习旨在利用来自拥有大量标记样本的源域的知识，并将其迁移到目标域。 例如，基于卷积神经网络的检测器（CNND）[ 47 ] 和采用孪生网络的元学习方法（MLSN）[ 48 ] 先在分类数据集上预训练，再将知识迁移到检测数据集。 除光谱知识迁移之外，一种名为「从高分辨率 RGB 图像进行 HTD 的迁移学习」（TLH 2 TD）[ 49 ] 的近期方法还引入了来自包含类似小目标的 RGB 图像的空间特征，采用逐框检测来捕捉形态特征。 尽管这些迁移学习方法缓解了标记数据有限的问题，但它们可能受到域漂移的影响，即从源域获取的知识在应用于目标域时变得不匹配。 样本增强方法通过生成合成样本来扩充训练数据集，并训练有监督的二分类模型进行检测。 例如，HTD-Net [ 50 ] 采用 U 形自编码器生成目标像素，并使用线性策略选择背景像素。 用于目标检测的双流 CNN（TSCNTD）[ 51 ] 通过稀疏表示识别背景像素，并将其与目标先验混合，以确保目标样本充足。 用于目标检测的孪生 Transformer 网络（STTD）[ 24 ] 通过端元提取、解混和再过滤来提取高纯度的背景样本，同时通过目标光谱的随机线性混合生成混合的目标与背景样本。 基于三元组光谱 Transformer 的目标检测器（TSTTD）[ 52 ] 将原始高光谱像素视为背景，并通过将它们与目标光谱混合来合成目标样本。 尽管这些方法性能可观，但样本增强方法可能引入知识偏差和噪声，导致训练数据与测试数据之间的分布不匹配，从而造成漏检或虚警。

paragraphs.en: Unsupervised methods typically employ autoencoders to reconstruct HSI, aiming to extract critical latent features, enhance relevant information, and suppress interference for improved background-target discrimination. For example, the distance-constrained stacked sparse autoencoder (DCSSAE) [ 53 ] maximizes the distance between the target prior and typical background spectra to extract discriminative features. The unconstrained linear mixture model with deep learning (ULMMDL) [ 54 ] uses a hierarchical denoising autoencoder to enhance target spectral consistency and suppress background interference, followed by a two-step subspace projection for target enhancement. Given the availability of sufficient background pixels, reconstructing the background has emerged as an effective detection strategy. The target suppression constraint-based background learning (BLTSC) method [ 26 ] employs an AAE to estimate the background distribution, detecting targets by measuring the spectral distance between the reconstructed background and the original HSI. Building on this, the orthogonal subspace-guided variational autoencoder (OS-VAE) [ 55 ] introduces an orthogonal subspace loss to reduce the impact of suspicious target samples, thereby enhancing background purity. Recently, contrastive learning, a prominent self-supervised approach, has gained attention for its ability to extract supervisory information from unlabeled data and capture instance distinctions. The self-supervised spectral-level contrastive learning-based HTD (SCLHTD) method [ 25 ] partitions spectral bands into even and odd groups, processing them through two AAEs to extract intrinsic feature representations. Spectral-level contrastive training enforces semantic consistency among feature vectors of the same pixel while distinguishing them from those of others. Additionally, the spectral graph contrast clustering assignment (SGCCA) method [ 56 ] integrates graph theory by constructing a spectral graph of pixel spectra and leveraging graph convolution networks and Transformers to extract local-global structural features, providing new insights for HTD. While these unsupervised methods eliminate the need for large labeled samples and demonstrate promising performance, their reliance on spectral feature comparison while often overlooking distribution learning, may limit robustness when applied to complex real-world scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 无监督方法通常采用自编码器重构高光谱图像（HSI），旨在提取关键的潜在特征、增强相关信息并抑制干扰，从而改进背景与目标的判别。 例如，距离约束堆叠稀疏自编码器（DCSSAE）[ 53 ] 通过最大化目标先验与典型背景光谱之间的距离来提取判别性特征。 结合深度学习的无约束线性混合模型（ULMMDL）[ 54 ] 使用分层去噪自编码器来增强目标光谱一致性并抑制背景干扰，随后采用两步子空间投影进行目标增强。 鉴于背景像素充足，重构背景已成为一种有效的检测策略。 基于目标抑制约束的背景学习方法（BLTSC）[ 26 ] 采用对抗自编码器估计背景分布，通过度量重构背景与原始高光谱图像之间的光谱距离来检测目标。 在此基础上，正交子空间引导的变分自编码器（OS-VAE）[ 55 ] 引入正交子空间损失以减少可疑目标样本的影响，从而提高背景纯度。 近年来，对比学习作为一种突出的自监督方法，因其能够从无标签数据中提取监督信息并捕捉实例差异而备受关注。 基于自监督光谱级对比学习的高光谱目标检测方法（SCLHTD）[ 25 ] 将光谱波段划分为奇偶两组，分别通过两个对抗自编码器处理，以提取内在特征表示。 光谱级对比训练在强制同一像素的特征向量保持语义一致的同时，将其与其他像素的特征向量区分开来。 此外，光谱图对比聚类分配方法（SGCCA）[ 56 ] 融合图论思想，通过构建像素光谱的光谱图，并利用图卷积网络与 Transformer 提取局部—全局结构特征，为高光谱目标检测提供了新思路。 虽然这些无监督方法无需大量标注样本且表现出良好的性能，但它们依赖光谱特征比较而往往忽视分布学习，这可能限制其在复杂真实场景中的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have garnered significant attention due to their ability to learn data distributions and generate high-quality, realistic samples. The pioneering work, DDPM [ 29 ] , captures data distributions by gradually adding noise to the data to form a noisy sequence, followed by a reverse denoising process to recover the original data. The training objective focuses on maximizing the variational lower bound. Compared with AEs and GANs, DDPM demonstrates superior generation quality and robustness. As a result, DDPM-based models have been widely applied across various fields. In HSI processing, diffusion models have primarily been explored for tasks such as HSI classification [ 57 , 58 ] , unmixing [ 59 , 60 ] , and super-resolution [ 61 , 62 ] . However, their application in HTD remains limited. Ma et al. [ 30 ] introduced the first diffusion model for hyperspectral anomaly detection, treating the background as Gaussian noise and constructing a specialized Markov chain to suppress it. To better estimate clean backgrounds, Chen et al. [ 31 ] proposed a dual-window spectral diffusion model that progressively mixes each anomaly pixel with surrounding background information in the forward process and restores the clean background in the reverse process. Li et al. [ 32 ] designed a conditional diffusion model for underwater target detection, generating multiple underwater images to simulate spectral variability, guided by principal component-based HSI. Despite these advancements, these methods primarily use diffusion models as auxiliary tools to enhance background-target separation. A fully end-to-end framework based on diffusion models for HTD remains unexplored.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose a spectral conditional diffusion model that directly generates the detection map in an end-to-end manner. Specifically, the model treats background and target confidence scores as negative and positive samples, respectively, and diffuses them into noisy sequences during the forward process. A lightweight denoising network is designed to reconstruct clean confidence scores, conditioned on the corresponding spectra, and guided by a tailored background-target separation loss that enhances discriminability. In the reverse process, the model starts from Gaussian noise and progressively generates the detection map, conditioned on the original HSI. By integrating distribution learning into a fully end-to-end framework, the proposed model significantly improves both detection quality and efficiency.

paragraphs.en: The training stage consists of three key steps: confidence score construction, confidence score diffusion, and spectral conditional denoising. In the first step, the original hyperspectral pixel is treated as the background, while a mixed pixel, obtained by mixing it with the target prior via the LMM, represents the target. A batch of randomly sampled target and background pixels is compared with the target prior, and their cosine similarities define the positive and negative confidence scores. During diffusion, Gaussian noise is progressively added to the confidence score pairs, forming noisy sequences. These sequences are then denoised using a CDNet, where the corresponding pixel spectra serve as guiding conditions to capture the distribution of confidence scores. To effectively recover confidence scores and enhance target-background separability, the denoising process is optimized with a background-target separation loss. This loss integrates CEM loss, which enhances target responses while suppressing the background, and BCE loss, which enforces binary classification of background and target pixels for improved separation.
paragraphs.zh: 训练阶段包含三个关键步骤：置信度分数构建、置信度分数扩散以及光谱条件去噪。 在第一步中，原始高光谱像素被视为背景，而通过线性混合模型（LMM）将目标先验与该像素混合得到的混合像素则代表目标。 将一批随机采样的目标和背景像素与目标先验进行比较，它们的余弦相似度定义了正置信度分数和负置信度分数。 在扩散过程中，高斯噪声被逐步添加到置信度分数对上，形成含噪序列。 随后使用CDNet对这些序列进行去噪，其中对应的像素光谱作为引导条件，以捕获置信度分数的分布。 为了有效恢复置信度分数并增强目标与背景的可分性，去噪过程通过背景-目标分离损失进行优化。 该损失整合了CEM损失和BCE损失，前者在增强目标响应的同时抑制背景，后者对背景和目标像素强制进行二分类，从而提升分离效果。

paragraphs.en: To capture the distributional discrepancy between target and background, we propose a binary score diffusion model that diffuses the confidence scores associated with both positive (target) and negative (background) samples, and reconstructs them conditioned on the spectral characteristics of each pixel. Drawing inspiration from DDPM, this model comprises a forward diffusion process and a reverse sampling process, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . In the forward process, Gaussian noise is progressively added to the confidence scores, leading to their corruption. Conversely, the reverse process begins with Gaussian noise and progressively recovers the scores, conditioned on the corresponding pixel spectra.
paragraphs.zh: 为了捕捉目标与背景之间的分布差异，我们提出了一种二元分数扩散模型，该模型对与正样本（目标）和负样本（背景）相关联的置信度分数进行扩散，并以每个像素的光谱特征为条件对其进行重构。 受 DDPM 的启发，该模型包含一个前向扩散过程和一个反向采样过程，如图 2 所示。 在前向过程中，高斯噪声被逐步添加到置信度分数上，导致其被破坏。 相反，反向过程从高斯噪声出发，以对应的像素光谱为条件，逐步恢复这些分数。

paragraphs.en: To effectively recover confidence scores and distinguish between background and target, spectral conditional denoising is applied, involving the design of the denoising network and the formulation of the objective loss function.
paragraphs.zh: 为了有效恢复置信度得分并区分背景与目标，本文采用谱条件去噪方法，包括去噪网络的设计和目标损失函数的构建。

paragraphs.en: The classical DDPM employs a UNet architecture with attention mechanisms as its denoising network. However, this architecture is not well-suited for denoising confidence scores due to the scalar nature of the data and the high computational efficiency demands in practical applications. To address this, we propose CDNet, a lightweight network based on a fully connected residual architecture, as shown in Fig. 3 . The CDNet f θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , 𝐁 p , t ) f_{\theta}({\bf x}_{t},{\bf B}_{p},t) consists of an initial linear layer, intermediate residual layers, and a final linear layer. The initial linear layer maps each confidence score to a higher-dimensional vector space. The intermediate residual layers comprise two residual blocks, where each block first extracts nonlinear features and then fuses them with the timestep and conditional embeddings. Similar to DDPM, the timestep is embedded using the Transformer sinusoidal position embedding [ 63 ] , followed by an MLP. For the conditional embedding, the corresponding pixel spectra of the confidence scores are injected through a simple linear layer and an MLP to guide the distribution learning of confidence scores. The fused features then pass through an additional MLP block to integrate and refine the features. To prevent gradient vanishing, the refined features are added to the initial features via a residual connection. Finally, the last linear layer recovers the extracted features into confidence scores. sents.en: The classical DDPM employs a UNet architecture with attention mechanisms as its denoising network.
sents.zh: 经典的DDPM采用带注意力机制的UNet架构作为其去噪网络。

sents.en: However, this architecture is not well-suited for denoising confidence scores due to the scalar nature of the data and the high computational efficiency demands in practical applications.
sents.zh: 然而，由于置信分数是标量数据，且实际应用对计算效率要求很高，这种架构并不适合用于置信分数的去噪。

sents.en: To address this, we propose CDNet, a lightweight network based on a fully connected residual architecture, as shown in Fig. 3 .
sents.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了CDNet，一种基于全连接残差架构的轻量级网络，如图3所示。

sents.en: The CDNet f θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , 𝐁 p , t ) f_{\theta}({\bf x}_{t},{\bf B}_{p},t) consists of an initial linear layer, intermediate residual layers, and a final linear layer.
sents.zh: CDNet f θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , 𝐁 p , t ) f_{\theta}({\bf x}_{t},{\bf B}_{p},t) 由一个初始线性层、若干中间残差层和一个最终线性层组成。

sents.en: The initial linear layer maps each confidence score to a higher-dimensional vector space.
sents.zh: 初始线性层将每个置信分数映射到更高维的向量空间。

sents.en: The intermediate residual layers comprise two residual blocks, where each block first extracts nonlinear features and then fuses them with the timestep and conditional embeddings.
sents.zh: 中间残差层包含两个残差块，每个块先提取非线性特征，然后将其与时间步和条件嵌入进行融合。

sents.en: Similar to DDPM, the timestep is embedded using the Transformer sinusoidal position embedding [ 63 ] , followed by an MLP.
sents.zh: 与DDPM类似，时间步采用Transformer正弦位置嵌入[ 63 ]进行嵌入，随后接一个MLP。

sents.en: For the conditional embedding, the corresponding pixel spectra of the confidence scores are injected through a simple linear layer and an MLP to guide the distribution learning of confidence scores.
sents.zh: 对于条件嵌入，通过一个简单的线性层和一个MLP注入置信分数对应的像素光谱，以引导置信分数的分布学习。

sents.en: The fused features then pass through an additional MLP block to integrate and refine the features.
sents.zh: 融合后的特征随后经过一个额外的MLP块进行特征的整合与精炼。

sents.en: To prevent gradient vanishing, the refined features are added to the initial features via a residual connection.
sents.zh: 为防止梯度消失，精炼后的特征通过残差连接加回到初始特征上。

sents.en: Finally, the last linear layer recovers the extracted features into confidence scores.
sents.zh: 最后，最后一个线性层将提取到的特征恢复为置信分数。

After removing water vapor absorption and noisy bands (1-4, 76, 87, 101-111, 136-153, and 198-210), 162 bands remain. For detection experiments, a commonly used 80 × 100 80\times 100 pixel subimage is extracted. The targets in this subimage are several vehicles, occupying a total of 19 pixels.

paragraphs.en: Both qualitative and quantitative metrics are used to assess detection performance. The qualitative evaluation includes visualized detection maps, 3D receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis [ 67 ] , and the background-target separability diagram. The detection map provides an intuitive visualization of detection effectiveness. The 3D ROC curve represents the relationship among detection probability P d {\rm P_{d}} , false alarm rate P f {\rm P_{f}} , and threshold τ \tau . Three derived 2D ROC curves of ( P f {\rm P_{f}} , P d {\rm P_{d}} ), ( τ \tau , P f {\rm P_{f}} ), and ( τ \tau , P d {\rm P_{d}} ) are used to evaluate detection effectiveness, background suppression, and target detectability, respectively. The background-target separability diagram further assesses the degree of separation between background and target. For quantitative evaluation, three basic areas under the ROC curves (AUCs) are considered: AUC ( P f , P d ) {\rm AUC}_{(\rm P_{f},P_{d})} , AUC ( τ , P f ) {\rm AUC}_{(\tau,{\rm P_{f}})} , and AUC ( τ , P d ) {\rm AUC}_{(\tau,{\rm P_{d}})} . Additionally, two composite metrics [ 68 ] , AUC OA {\rm AUC}_{{\rm OA}} and AUC SNPR {\rm AUC}_{{\rm SNPR}} , are used to assess overall detection quality.
paragraphs.zh: 定性和定量指标均用于评估检测性能。 定性评估包括可视化的检测图、三维接收机工作特性（ROC）分析 [ 67 ] 以及背景-目标可分性图。 检测图提供了检测效果的直观可视化。 三维 ROC 曲线表示检测概率 P d {\rm P_{d}} 、虚警率 P f {\rm P_{f}} 与阈值 τ \tau 三者之间的关系。 三个衍生的二维 ROC 曲线，即 ( P f {\rm P_{f}} , P d {\rm P_{d}} )、( τ \tau , P f {\rm P_{f}} ) 和 ( τ \tau , P d {\rm P_{d}} )，分别用于评估检测效果、背景抑制和目标可检测性。 背景-目标可分性图进一步评估背景与目标之间的分离程度。 在定量评估中，考虑三个 ROC 曲线下的基本面积（AUC）：AUC ( P f , P d ) {\rm AUC}_{(\rm P_{f},P_{d})} 、AUC ( τ , P f ) {\rm AUC}_{(\tau,{\rm P_{f}})} 和 AUC ( τ , P d ) {\rm AUC}_{(\tau,{\rm P_{d}})} 。 此外，还使用两个复合指标 [ 68 ] ，即 AUC OA {\rm AUC}_{{\rm OA}} 和 AUC SNPR {\rm AUC}_{{\rm SNPR}} ，来评估整体检测质量。

paragraphs.en: For the competing methods, we run the publicly available source codes with their optimal hyper-parameters as reported in the original papers. The proposed SCDM-HTD is implemented in Python 3.10.14 using the PyTorch 2.1.1 framework and trained on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU with 24 GB memory. The batch size B B is set to 256, and the total number of timestep T T is 500. The penalty parameter μ \mu in the CEM loss is is fixed at 10 for all datasets. The regulariztion parameter λ \lambda , which balances the CEM loss and the BCE loss, is set to 1, 10 − 3 10^{-3} , 1, and 10 − 4 10^{-4} for MULL Gulfport, HYDICE, Airport-4, and Urban-2, respectively. For optimization, we use the AdamW optimizer with a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The learning rate is initialized at 10 − 4 10^{-4} , follows a warmup schedule for the first 10 % 10\% epochs, and then decreases following a cosine decay schedule. The model is trained for a total of 200 epochs. During inference, the number of sampling steps S S is set to 5 for all datsets.
paragraphs.zh: 对于对比方法，我们使用其原始论文中报告的最优超参数运行公开可用的源代码。 所提出的 SCDM-HTD 在 Python 3.10.14 中基于 PyTorch 2.1.1 框架实现，并在具有 24 GB 显存的 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 GPU 上进行训练。 批大小 B B 设为 256，总时间步数 T T 为 500。 CEM 损失中的惩罚参数 μ \mu 在所有数据集上固定为 10。 用于平衡 CEM 损失和 BCE 损失的正则化参数 λ \lambda 在 MULL Gulfport、HYDICE、Airport-4 和 Urban-2 上分别设为 1、10 − 3 10^{-3}、1 和 10 − 4 10^{-4}。 在优化方面，我们使用权重衰减为 10 − 4 10^{-4} 的 AdamW 优化器。 学习率初始化为 10 − 4 10^{-4}，在前 10 % 10\% 的轮次中采用预热调度，随后按照余弦衰减调度进行下降。 模型总共训练 200 个轮次。 在推理阶段，所有数据集的采样步数 S S 均设为 5。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the qualitative performance of SCDM-HTD, we visualize the detection maps in Fig. 4 . All competing methods achieve some level of detection performance. However, OSP, CEM, CSCR, and WDCCR exhibit weak background suppression, while BLTSC, HTD-Net, TSTTD, and OS-VAE tend to miss the targets to varying degrees. In contrast, the proposed SCDM-HTD maintains a promising balance between target saliency and background suppression. Fig. 5 presents the ROC curves for the competing methods. The 2D ROC curves of ( P f , P d ) \rm(P_{f},P_{d}) , ( τ , P f ) \rm(\tau,P_{f}) , and ( τ , P d ) \rm(\tau,P_{d}) for SCDM-HTD are predominantly located in the upper-left, lower-left, and upper-right corners, respectively. This demonstrates its strong performance in detection effectiveness, background suppression, and target detectability. Fig. 6 displays the background-target separability diagrams of the competing methods. Compared to other methods, SCDM-HTD exhibits a larger margin between the background and target boxes, highlighting its outstanding discrimination ability. Additionally, the smaller background box further emphasizes its superior background suppression.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 SCDM-HTD 的定性性能，我们在图 4 中可视化了检测结果图。所有对比方法都达到了一定程度的检测性能。然而，OSP、CEM、CSCR 和 WDCCR 表现出较弱的目标背景抑制能力，而 BLTSC、HTD-Net、TSTTD 和 OS-VAE 则不同程度地漏检目标。相比之下，所提出的 SCDM-HTD 在目标显著性和背景抑制之间保持了良好的平衡。图 5 展示了各对比方法的 ROC 曲线。SCDM-HTD 的 ( P f , P d ) \rm(P_{f},P_{d}) 、( τ , P f ) \rm(\tau,P_{f}) 和 ( τ , P d ) \rm(\tau,P_{d}) 的 2D ROC 曲线分别主要位于左上角、左下角和右上角。这表明其在检测效果、背景抑制和目标可检测性方面具有出色的性能。图 6 展示了各对比方法的背景-目标可分性图。与其他方法相比，SCDM-HTD 在背景框和目标框之间表现出更大的间隔，凸显了其出色的判别能力。此外，更小的背景框进一步强调了其卓越的背景抑制能力。

paragraphs.en: To assess the quantitative performance of the proposed SCDM-HTD, Table II presents the AUC results for the competing methods. SCDM-HTD achieves the highest score on the key metric, AUC ( P f , P d ) \rm{AUC}_{(P_{f},P_{d})} , confirming its superior detection effectiveness. It also demonstrates competitive performance across AUC ( τ , P f ) \rm{AUC}_{(\tau,P_{f})} , AUC ( τ , P d ) \rm{AUC}_{(\tau,P_{d})} , AUC OA \rm{AUC}_{\rm{OA}} , and AUC SNPR \rm{AUC}_{\rm{SNPR}} , highlighting its consistent reliability for high-confidence detection. Table II also reports the running times of all competing methods. Statistical-based methods such as OSP and CEM are the fastest due to their simplified computations. The proposed SCDM-HTD, while maintaining high performance, also achieves low computational cost thanks to its lightweight model and the accelerated reverse sampling process. This efficiency makes it particularly well-suited for practical applications.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate the contributions of the background-target separation loss and the reverse sampling acceleration to the overall performance of the proposed method.

To assess its effectiveness, we first compare it with the diffusion loss. As shown in Table III , the proposed background-target separation loss significantly outperforms the diffusion loss. This improvement arises because the diffusion loss only reconstructs confidence scores based on cosine similarity, whereas the separation loss not only emphasizes the target but also suppresses the background, effectively differentiating them into distinct classes.

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces a spectral-wise conditional diffusion model to address the issue of neglecting distribution learning in HTD. Unlike existing methods, our model reformulates HTD as a task of generating a detection map that learns the distributional discrepancy for effective background-target separation. Specifically, we first construct background and target confidence scores using linear mixing and spectral similarity computation. These confidence scores are treated as training samples, with the corresponding pixel spectra acting as guiding conditions, and are fed into the conditional diffusion model. The confidence scores are corrupted by adding Gaussian noise, and we propose a lightweight MLP-based CDNet to recover them. Furthermore, we introduce a composite loss function to enhance background-target separation. This loss integrates CEM loss to highlight the target while suppressing the background, and BCE loss to classify them into two distinct classes, thus improving detection robustness. Finally, we adopt a deterministic non-Markov chain to accelerate the reverse sampling process, requiring only a few steps to generate the detection map. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves outstanding performance in terms of objective metrics, subjective visual quality, and real-time requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种逐光谱条件扩散模型，以解决HTD中忽视分布学习的问题。 与现有方法不同，我们的模型将HTD重新表述为生成检测图的任务，该检测图学习分布差异以实现有效的背景-目标分离。 具体而言，我们首先利用线性混合和光谱相似度计算构建背景与目标的置信度分数。 这些置信度分数被视为训练样本，以对应的像素光谱作为引导条件，输入到条件扩散模型中。 通过添加高斯噪声对置信度分数进行破坏，并提出了一种基于多层感知机的轻量级CDNet来恢复它们。 此外，我们引入了复合损失函数以增强背景-目标分离。 该损失函数整合了用于突出目标并抑制背景的CEM损失，以及用于将二者分类为两个不同类别的BCE损失，从而提升检测的鲁棒性。 最后，我们采用确定性的非马尔可夫链来加速反向采样过程，只需少量步骤即可生成检测图。 大量实验表明，我们的模型在客观指标、主观视觉质量以及实时性要求方面均取得了出色的性能。
